notes: Clean scanned 2-sheet Ricardo GA for a RALPH 400 belt-drive bungalow (home) lift, G+2, up to 408 kg, 0.5 m/s, single phase, glass cabin, in a 1500x1500 structural steel shaft. Sheet 1 (landscape): hoistway plan, Sec A-A (top-floor entrance elevation with controller + ground-floor strip), DB details, notes, features list, spec table. Sheet 2 (portrait): vertical section (travel 7860, overhead 3000, pit 170, slab 150, bracket space 1700), pit forces plan with E0 rail force diagrams, floor-height table, repeated spec/title block (mislabelled SHT. 1 OF 2). Doors are SS auto telescopic with long vision glass at all landings; plan shows panels parking to the left (LHS) - the 340|360 split over OPENING 700 is the section-line position, not a panel split. Cantilever-style: car rails (DBG 860) and cwt rails (DBG 820) both on the left wall. Scan slightly skewed with blue-ink approval signature; otherwise highly legible.
